findings: src/sim.js settle() permits tank overlap near walls: with AI off, computer at (17,0) and player at (18.8,-1.6) heading 90, holding W for 2 seconds leaves their centres 2.291 units apart instead of at least 2.4.

src/sim.js moveShell() reflects the wrong velocity component at inner-wall corners: firing from (6.8,1) heading 90 leaves the shell travelling forward after its first contact and removes it on the next step against the same wall.
The gate passes all 26 tests but takes 135.058 seconds, exceeding the repository's two-minute suite limit.

src/sim.js spawns shells inside walls when firing at contact: placing the player at (5.8, 8), heading 0, then firing makes the shell disappear after two steps without reflecting back toward the player.

src/sim.js checks shell hits only at step endpoints, missing real grazing collisions: firing from (0, 0), heading 0, past a computer at (5.225, 1.449) leaves its health at 100 although the shell crosses its collision circle.

src/sim.js moveShell reflects both velocity components near inner-wall corners incorrectly: firing from (5.15, 4.1) at heading 20 reverses x velocity even though the contact normal requires it to remain positive.
src/sim.js moveShell ignores exact tangential contact because it uses a strict inequality: firing from (0, 0) at heading 0 past a computer at (5.225, 1.45) leaves its health at 100 instead of 75.
